words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) opens the ayah by placing the reader inside a referent already carried from 98:1-2 before the writings are named. Its feminine suffix can resume the clear proof of 98:1 or the purified pages of 98:2, so the word should not force only one container where the grammar keeps both accessible. The preposition makes that carried referent a locative predicate for {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}): the point is not merely association or source, but contents found within the proof or pages. Because the locative comes first, the known container frames the new disclosure; the movement shifts from the recitation scene of 98:2 into a compressed nominal assertion about what those pages or that proof contain.

words.prose: {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}) is the delayed nominative subject disclosed after {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}), so the writings are what the carried proof or pages contain. Its indefinite plural avoids naming one definite title and instead presents multiple written contents by kind and quality, preparing the closing adjective to define what sort of writings they are. The {{ar:ك ت ب}} ({{tr:k-t-b}}) family gives the noun more than a bare book-label: writing, joining, and binding decree converge here as recorded contents that also carry prescriptive order, while the local form remains a concrete plural noun, not an abstract verb. The word also belongs to the surah's book-thread around 98:1, 98:4, and 98:6, and its pairing with {{ar:قَيِّمَةٌ}} ({{tr:qayyimatun}}) makes written content and upright ordering mutually interpretive. Their shared final tanwīn cadence lets the noun and its quality land audibly as one compact phrase.

topics.headline: indefinite plural distributes the contents

topics.reason: Attachment evidence binds {{ar:قَيِّمَةٌ}} ({{tr:qayyimatun}}) directly to {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}), and the CRITICAL rows supply the concrete 9:36 and 98:5 witnesses for the wider pairing.

words.prose: {{ar:قَيِّمَةٌ}} ({{tr:qayyimatun}}) closes the ayah as the adjective of {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}), with feminine singular agreement attaching the quality to the broken plural writings rather than to the earlier suffix. The word does not merely say that the writings exist; in a verbless clause it evaluates them as a standing quality: upright, corrective, worthy, and internally sound. Its doubled intensive shape makes that uprightness inherent rather than a simple standing posture, and the central doubled sound makes that density audible. The local adjective also belongs to a constrained upright-religion formula field, with witnesses at 9:36, 12:40, and 30:30, while keeping the selected field away from unrelated {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) branches such as people, bodily rising, or resurrection. Within the surah, this quality anticipates the move from upright writings in 98:3 to upright religion and established practice in 98:5, so textual correctness becomes enacted order; its shared final tanwīn cadence with {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}) lets the ayah land as a balanced noun-and-quality phrase.

topics.headline: feminine singular adjective binds to the broken plural

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:قَيِّمَةٌ}} ({{tr:qayyimatun}}) as a feminine singular qualitative adjective modifying the broken plural {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}).

topics.headline: verbless adjective makes uprightness a standing assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears uprightness as a standing quality of the writings, not as something newly made or narrated.
topics.reason: The clause is nominal and compressed, so the adjective completes the assertion without an event verb.

topics.headline: uprightness, correction, subsistence, and value converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the adjective judge the writings as upright, corrective, and worthy from within their own structure, while unrelated root branches stay outside the local sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports straightness, establishing, support, and value branches for {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}), but the local word is a qualitative adjective of writings, so the broader family is narrowed to textual uprightness, correction, subsistence, and worth.

topics.headline: doubled form intensifies inherent correctness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the adjective as denser than a simple standing participle, making correctness feel built into the writings.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a qualitative adjective on an intensive doubled pattern, and the phonetic row is tied to the actual local form.

topics.headline: qualitative q-w-m field is specialized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a specialized upright-religion formula field, with witnesses such as 9:36, 12:40, and 30:30, applied here first to writings.
topics.reason: The exact count in the CRITICAL row is less important than the supported constraint: this local adjective belongs to a specialized qualitative uprightness field rather than the root's unrelated people or resurrection branches.

topics.headline: uprightness is attached to written contents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees correctness as a property of the texts themselves, not as a free-floating moral abstraction.
topics.reason: The adjective is syntactically attached to {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}), preserving the CRITICAL claim that {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) uprightness is textual here.

topics.headline: upright writings anticipate upright practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quality attached to writings in 98:3 returns in 98:5 as religion and practice, moving from textual correctness to enacted order.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the concrete same-surah recurrence at 98:5, and local syntax first anchors the quality in the writings of 98:3.

topics.headline: final adjective seals the ayah with quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the short ayah land on the writings' upright quality rather than merely on the fact that writings exist.
topics.reason: The adjective is the final word of the ayah, shares the nominative indefinite cadence with {{ar:كُتُبٌ}} ({{tr:kutubun}}), and marks the transition from externally purified pages in 98:2 to internally upright contents in 98:3.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural writings at word 2 and their q-w-m adjective at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: K-t-b supplies both assembled parts and letters joined as writing, while q-w-m supplies straightness and evenness. The phrase therefore presents multiple written units whose rightness includes coherent internal arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another makes the plural writings an integrated assembly rather than a loose heap.
Letters joined into a written object fixes the assembly specifically in textual form.
Straightness, balance, and just speech make coherence an upright normative arrangement.

changed_reading.before: Books that are simply good or correct.
changed_reading.after: A plurality of written units whose joined components form a coherent, upright arrangement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same k-t-b noun can denote binding inscription, and the q-w-m adjective can denote guardianship and support.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inscription that imposes judgment is paired with what maintains, governs, and keeps a thing standing. The writings are therefore potentially operative instruments that establish and sustain an order, not merely descriptions of one.

activation_trace.role: Binding decree turns writing into an effective prescription or settled judgment.
Care, guardianship, and maintenance give the adjective an active order-preserving role.
Mainstay and subsistence make the writings supports by which a larger system remains standing.

changed_reading.after: Binding inscriptions that actively maintain and support a durable order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural k-t-b form can evoke registered entries, while q-w-m includes valuation and exact measure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Registration, appraisal, and equal measure combine into a documentary mechanism: the writings can be read as records that assign standing according to a stable scale.

activation_trace.role: Entry into a register supplies the documentary act of placing persons or matters into an ordered record.
Value and appraisal supply the scale by which registered entries receive standing.
Equal weight and exact measure constrain appraisal to a balanced standard.

changed_reading.after: Writings functioning as an appraised register whose entries are set by exact measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier singular book serves as a marker of group belonging, but the focus shifts to indefinite plural writings and qualifies their internal standing. This relocates attention from inherited affiliation with a book to the articulated contents by which such affiliation can be assessed.

activation_trace.role: Joined components make the focus plural an inspectable internal assembly.
Straightness supplies the criterion applied to those internal written units.
Nearness and belonging make the earlier book phrase a social affiliation label.
The singular written book is the object around which that affiliation is named.

structural_cues: 98:1 places the belonging term before a definite singular book, whereas 98:3 uses an indefinite plural of writings inside fiha.

strongest_changes: The sheets and recitation sequence turn the writings from stored objects into ordered units whose integrity persists through delivery.
The post-evidence dispersal reverses a simple unity model: internally joined writings can expose externally scattered reception.
The q-w-m recurrence in enacted practice makes uprightness operational and sustaining, not merely descriptive.
The opposed appraisals and durable recompense activate registry, measure, and fulfilled-settlement dimensions.
summary.what_was_special: The very short focus phrase behaved as a hinge between two rich branch systems: k-t-b moved among assembly, inscription, decree, registry, and contract, while q-w-m moved among straightness, maintenance, support, valuation, and standing. Context did not collapse these into one gloss; it made several mechanisms independently functional.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly suggests the sheets as the referent of fiha, but the exact distributive relation between sheets and plural writings remains open.
Straightness, active maintenance, and appraisal all fit q-w-m; the packet does not force one to exhaust the adjective.
The contractual-release, intact-but-blind, and vertical-stress readings are branch-grounded analogies and should not be promoted to direct lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Inside the sheets: written decrees that stand upright.** Evidence: ك ت ب B002 writing/book and B003 binding decree; ق و م B008 straightness/uprightness, B004 care/maintenance, B009 mainstay/support. Structural cue: 98:2 has صحفا مطهرة; 98:5 repeats دين القيمة and يقيموا الصلاة. Assigned role: كتب are the contents that bind; قيمة names their rectifying, sustaining posture. Abductive move: I infer that the “books” are not merely textual units but prescriptions that make a way stand. Reading change: the ayah reads as “inside them are stabilizing ordinances,” not only “valuable writings.”

2. **Plural books resisting fragmentation.** Evidence: ك ت ب B001 joining one thing to another; ق و م B007 standing in another’s place and B008 straightness; ف ر ق in 98:4 B002 scattering. Structural cue: “فيها كتب” is immediately followed by the people of the book splitting after proof. Assigned role: the books are a joined plurality held upright against later human dispersal. Abductive move: I supply the contrast that ordered plurality in revelation exposes disordered plurality among recipients. Reading change: plurality here is not confusion; it is a structured multiplicity that judges later fragmentation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:5’s “ذلك دين القيّمة” was the main surprise: قيمة in 98:3 is not only a property of texts but becomes the name of an enacted religion. 98:4 then made the ordered plurality of كتب contrast with social تفرّق.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Joined textual units inside a plural carrier.** **Lexical evidence:** `كُتُب` anchors `ك ت ب` B001, “joining one thing to another,” as well as B002, joined letters and written books. **Structural cue and role:** `فِيهَا` nests the plural writings inside the plural purified sheets of 98:2; 98:4 then sets that ordered containment against the recipients’ `تَفَرَّقَ`. B001 makes each writing an achieved assembly rather than an inert object. **Abductive move:** I infer that the material nesting models coherent plurality and that the following human scattering is a contrast to it. **Reading change:** `كُتُب` reads as organized joinings whose form silently tests whether a receiving community can remain joined.

2. **Writings that maintain an order.** **Lexical evidence:** `قَيِّمَة` anchors `ق و م` B004, “care, guardianship, and preservation,” and B009, “support, mainstay, and subsistence,” alongside B008, uprightness. **Structural cue and role:** 98:5 repeats the root in `يُقِيمُوا` and `دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَة`; prayer is maintained between those repetitions, and giving is coupled to it. The writings’ quality thus migrates into sustained practices that hold an order up. **Abductive move:** I infer that root repetition maps textual maintenance onto human maintenance; the packet supplies the recurrence but not the transfer rule. **Reading change:** `قَيِّمَة` means more than correct or straight: the writings are custodial supports meant to keep a form of life standing.

3. **Contents with directive force.** **Lexical evidence:** `كُتُب` also activates `ك ت ب` B003, “inscribing as binding decree or judgment.” **Structural cue and role:** the terse nominal description is followed by `أُمِرُوا` in 98:5 and by matched recompense in 98:8. The decree branch assigns the writings a normative role between disclosure and accountable response. **Abductive move:** I infer that the later command and recompense enact what the writings prescribe; neither later ayah explicitly says it is quoting these `كُتُب`. **Reading change:** the phrase becomes a compact statement about operative prescriptions, not merely valuable literary contents.

4. **A standard that appraises its readers.** **Lexical evidence:** `قَيِّمَة` activates `ق و م` B010, “value, valuation, and appraisal,” with B015, “equal weight and even measure,” as a secondary image. **Structural cue and role:** 98:6–98:7 rank two responses as `شَرّ` and `خَيْر` of the same `بَرِيَّة`, and 98:8 gives a recompense matching action (`ج ز ي` B001). The writings therefore function as an evaluative measure, not only as objects possessing value. **Abductive move:** I infer that the disclosed order supplies the criterion behind the later appraisal. **Reading change:** `قَيِّمَة` becomes reader-facing: these writings establish value by weighing what recipients do after they receive clarity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:5 was the lexical surprise: `يُقِيمُوا` and `دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَة` turned fixed `ق و م` B004 and B009 from qualities of writings into practices of maintenance. 98:6–98:7 then made B010’s valuation reader-facing through the paired `شَرّ/خَيْر ٱلْبَرِيَّة`, and 98:8’s matching `ج ز ي` B001 supplied the retrospective consequence of B003’s binding-decree reading for fixed `ك ت ب`.

facets.statement: Sahip ile köleleştirilmiş kişi arasında, kişinin kendi özgürlük bedelini ödemesini konu alan özel bir sözleşme kurulur.

Kararlaştırılan bedelin tamamlanması sözleşmenin sonucu olarak köleleştirilmiş kişinin özgür olmasını sağlar.
İlgili biçimler sözleşmenin kendisini, sözleşmeye bağlı köleleştirilmiş kişiyi ve bağlama göre sözleşmenin öteki tarafını gösterebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedeni dik konuma getirme ve dik durma çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadet sırasındaki duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde dik kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Canlı ya da cansız bir varlık dik konuma gelir veya dik durumda bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir malın bedelini belirleme işlemini, bu işlemle ortaya çıkan değeri ve tarafların bu değer üzerinde hesaplaşmasını destekler. Bir şeyin yerini tutma düşüncesi kökensel açıklamadır; dalın güncel çekirdeği değer biçme ve belirlenen bedeldir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ekonomik değer biçme ve bedelle sınırlıdır; genel olarak başkasının yerini alma veya temel dayanak değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Belirlenen bedel ile mala değer biçme yapıları ayrılır; kapsam genel değiş tokuşa veya yerini tutmaya genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir malın parasal değerini belirlemek ve bu değerlendirme sonucunda ortaya çıkan bedeldir; tarafların değer üzerinde karşılıklı hesaplaşması da bu alana bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir mala değer biçilir ve bu işlem sonucunda onun bedeli belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, malın bedelini değerlendirme yoluyla belirleme ve belirlenen değeri adlandırma çekirdeğinde birleşir; karşılıklı değer hesabı da buna bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Değerlendirme işlemi ile bu işlemden çıkan parasal sonucu birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Değer biçme işlemini ve belirlenen bedeli korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir malın parasal karşılığının değerlendirme yoluyla saptandığı bağlamda kullanılır.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
